_comment: Classes, subclasses, features and option lists of the Player's Handbook (2024), PDF pages 51-178. Names, pages and levels only.

entries.name: Improved Brutal Strike
entries.note: also 17

entries.name: Brutal Strike Effects
entries.note: chosen with Brutal Strike (level 9); two more at level 13

entries.name: Rage of the Wilds
entries.note: chosen each time Rage is activated (level 3)

entries.name: Aspect of the Wilds
entries.note: chosen after a Long Rest (level 6)

entries.name: Power of the Wilds
entries.note: chosen each time Rage is activated (level 14)

entries.name: Expertise
entries.note: also 9

entries.name: Combat Inspiration
entries.note: effects the inspired creature can choose from when it uses the die

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.note: adapted: preparing by the 2024 counts comes with Part C

entries.name: Cleric Subclass
entries.note: adapted: the Life and War Domains; the Light and Trickery Domains come with their expansions

entries.name: Divine Intervention
entries.note: adapted: the battle's judgement picks the spell the god casts, among the cleric spells the game has

entries.name: Greater Divine Intervention
entries.note: adapted: written on the sheet; Wish itself comes with Part D

entries.name: Turn Undead
entries.note: adapted: the turned flee the field (frightened and incapacitated for the fight)

entries.name: Divine Strike
entries.note: adapted: radiant (the necrotic choice is not asked)

entries.name: Life Domain Spells
entries.note: the spells not yet in the game (Aid, Aura of Life, Greater Restoration) are prepared as the catalogue brings them (Part D)

entries.name: War Domain Spells
entries.note: the spells not yet in the game (Magic Weapon, Crusader's Mantle, Fire Shield, Freedom of Movement, Steel Wind Strike) are prepared as the catalogue brings them (Part D)

entries.name: War God's Blessing
entries.note: adapted: the spell is cast without a slot; it still asks for concentration

entries.name: Wild Shape
entries.note: known forms by level: see option list Beast Shapes

entries.name: Primal Order
entries.note: chosen at level 1

entries.name: Elemental Fury
entries.note: chosen at level 7; Improved Elemental Fury (15) grows the chosen option

entries.name: Beast Shapes
entries.note: the Wild Shape table of known forms by Druid level; option level is the Druid level

entries.name: Druid Level 2
entries.note: 4 known forms, max CR 1/4, no Fly Speed

entries.name: Druid Level 4
entries.note: 6 known forms, max CR 1/2, no Fly Speed

entries.name: Druid Level 8
entries.note: 8 known forms, max CR 1, Fly Speed allowed

entries.name: Land Types
entries.note: chosen after each Long Rest (Circle of the Land Spells)

entries.name: Constellations
entries.note: chosen each time Starry Form is assumed

entries.name: Fighter Subclass
entries.note: adapted: the Champion, the Knight (Realmwalker's own), the Battle Master and the Eldritch Knight; the Psi Warrior comes with its expansion

entries.name: Tactical Shift
entries.note: adapted: the half speed is added to the turn's movement, and the turn's steps draw no opportunity attacks

entries.name: Combat Superiority
entries.note: Swapping a known maneuver when new ones are learned is left out; the maneuvers learned are kept.

entries.name: Know Your Enemy
entries.note: Weighing a creature up makes its kind known for the fight, as the Study action does: its card then shows its AC and hit points too, not only its immunities, resistances and weaknesses.

entries.name: Maneuver Options
entries.note: learned with Combat Superiority (3 at level 3, +2 at 7, 10, 15)

entries.name: Ambush
entries.note: At Initiative the battle adds the die when the roll is poor and two dice are left (the player is not asked before the order is known); on a Stealth check it is spent only when it can turn a failure.

entries.name: Bait and Switch
entries.note: Only with a friend who takes up one square, as the fighter does (so the two can trade places on the grid).

entries.name: Commanding Presence
entries.note: Spent only when the die can turn a failed check (as Tactical Mind).

entries.name: Disarming Attack
entries.note: The dropped weapon cannot be used until the start of its holder's next turn, when it is taken up again (2024 object interaction).

entries.name: Lunging Attack
entries.note: Having moved at least 5 feet this turn stands for the straight line just before the blow.

entries.name: Maneuvering Attack
entries.note: The friend in most danger beside the foe moves; it draws no blows from anyone as it goes, not only from the target.

entries.name: Tactical Assessment
entries.note: Spent only when the die can turn a failed check (as Tactical Mind).

entries.name: Remarkable Athlete
entries.note: adapted: the half speed after a critical hit is added to the turn's movement, and the turn's steps draw no opportunity attacks

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.note: A new level opens the whole prepared list for change until the next fight (the book: one spell a level); a cantrip is not swapped on a new level; a component pouch comes with the path.

entries.name: War Bond
entries.note: The hour's ritual is done at a rest, over the weapon in hand and a second of another reach (the game's choice); a third bond is never made. Called with the bonus action when thrown or carried in the pack; robbers cannot keep it; the watch's strongbox gives it back at the release.

entries.name: Arcane Charge
entries.note: Where to land is the battle's judgement: beside the weakest foe out of reach, before the extra action; no teleport when a foe is in reach already.

entries.name: Monk's Focus Features
entries.note: the three Focus Point features known from level 2; Heightened Focus (10) improves them

entries.name: Open Hand Technique
entries.note: effects imposed by hits from Flurry of Blows

entries.name: Fighting Style Alternatives
entries.note: offered instead of a Fighting Style feat (level 2)

entries.name: Channel Divinity Effects
entries.note: effect described inside Channel Divinity (level 3); other features add more

entries.name: Fighting Style Alternatives
entries.note: offered instead of a Fighting Style feat (level 2)

entries.name: Primal Companion Beasts
entries.note: stat block chosen when the beast is summoned (stat blocks on pp. 126-127)

entries.name: Stalker's Flurry Effects
entries.note: extra effects of Dreadful Strike (level 11)

entries.name: Hunter's Prey
entries.note: chosen at level 3, changed after a Short or Long Rest

entries.name: Defensive Tactics
entries.note: chosen at level 7, changed after a Short or Long Rest

entries.name: Thieves' Cant
entries.note: adapted: words only: the trade's slang is in the game's text, with no rule of its own

entries.name: Rogue Subclass
entries.note: adapted: the Thief, the Assassin and the Arcane Trickster; the Soulknife comes with its expansion

entries.name: Stroke of Luck
entries.note: adapted: on attack rolls and saving throws; an ability check's 20 is left to Reliable Talent

entries.name: Withdraw
entries.note: adapted: the half speed is added to the turn, and the turn's steps draw no opportunity attacks

entries.name: Daze
entries.note: adapted: a dazed creature keeps its action and loses its move and bonus action

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.note: A new level opens the whole prepared list for change until the next fight (the book: one spell a level); a cantrip is not swapped on a new level; Mage Hand is given and a component pouch comes with the path.

entries.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
entries.note: In a fight the unseen hand is set beside a creature with the bonus action (it serves Versatile Trickster); on the road it robs stalls and picks pockets with nobody seeing who; other Sleight of Hand through the hand (locks) is left out.

entries.name: Magical Ambush
entries.note: Hidden counts as the Invisible condition, as the 2024 Hide action gives it.

entries.name: Spell Thief
entries.note: Used by the battle's judgement on a harmful spell of level 1 or more; a stolen spell is kept until the next long rest (the book: 8 hours) and the caster cannot cast it again in that fight.

entries.name: Infiltration Expertise
entries.note: adapted: Roving Aim works; Masterful Mimicry is words on the sheet until disguises and forgery grow (Expansion 23)

entries.name: Fast Hands
entries.note: adapted: a bonus action uses an item; picking locks and pockets with it waits for the fight's own locks

entries.name: Supreme Sneak
entries.note: adapted: the Stealth Attack keeps the thief hidden; the cover at the turn's end is not asked

entries.name: Thief's Reflexes
entries.note: adapted: the second turn is folded into the first: a second action, bonus action and move in the first round

entries.name: Stealth Attack
entries.note: adapted: the Stealth Attack keeps the thief hidden; the cover at the turn's end is not asked

entries.name: Metamagic
entries.note: also 10, 17 (two more options each)

entries.name: Metamagic Options
entries.note: learned with Metamagic (2 at level 2, +2 at 10, +2 at 17)

entries.name: Revelation in Flesh Benefits
entries.note: one benefit per Sorcery Point spent (level 14)

entries.name: Elemental Affinity Damage Types
entries.note: chosen at level 6

entries.name: Wild Magic Surge Table
entries.note: the d100 table, 25 rows named by their roll range; Tamed Surge (18) picks a row (not 97-00)

entries.name: Mystic Arcanum
entries.note: also 13 (level 7 spell), 15 (level 8 spell), 17 (level 9 spell)

entries.name: Eldritch Invocations
entries.note: learned with Eldritch Invocations (1 at level 1, more at 2, 5, 7, 9, 12, 15, 18); option level is the Warlock level it needs

entries.name: Agonizing Blast
entries.note: repeatable; needs a damaging Warlock cantrip

entries.name: Devouring Blade
entries.note: needs Thirsting Blade

entries.name: Eldritch Smite
entries.note: needs Pact of the Blade

entries.name: Eldritch Spear
entries.note: repeatable; needs a damaging Warlock cantrip

entries.name: Gift of the Protectors
entries.note: needs Pact of the Tome

entries.name: Investment of the Chain Master
entries.note: needs Pact of the Chain

entries.name: Lessons of the First Ones
entries.note: repeatable

entries.name: Lifedrinker
entries.note: needs Pact of the Blade

entries.name: Pact of the Blade
entries.note: a pact boon

entries.name: Pact of the Chain
entries.note: a pact boon

entries.name: Pact of the Tome
entries.note: a pact boon

entries.name: Repelling Blast
entries.note: repeatable; needs a Warlock attack-roll cantrip

entries.name: Thirsting Blade
entries.note: needs Pact of the Blade

entries.name: Pact of the Chain Familiar Forms
entries.note: special forms for Find Familiar from Pact of the Chain; stat blocks in Appendix B

entries.name: Steps of the Fey Effects
entries.note: extra effects of Misty Step (level 3); Misty Escape (6) adds two

entries.name: Wizard
entries.note: adapted: the Evoker and the Abjurer; the Diviner and the Illusionist come with their expansion (5)

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.note: adapted: every spell in the spellbook is ready until preparing by the 2024 counts comes with Part C

entries.name: Arcane Recovery
entries.note: the highest slots first, as a wizard would choose

entries.name: Wizard Subclass
entries.note: adapted: the Evoker and the Abjurer; the Diviner and the Illusionist come with their expansion

entries.name: Spell Mastery
entries.note: adapted: the two spells are chosen at 18 and kept (changing them after a long rest is left out)

entries.name: Abjurer
entries.note: id `abjuration`, shown as the Abjurer

entries.name: Abjuration Savant
entries.note: two when the catalogue has two left to give (Part D brings the rest)

entries.name: Spell Breaker
entries.note: adapted: Counterspell always ready and its slot kept when the spell holds; Dispel Magic (a bonus action, proficiency added) comes with the catalogue, Part D.2

entries.name: Portent
entries.note: Laid by the battle's judgement (asked under the Reactions setting 'all'); outside fights on the party's camp and conversation checks.

entries.name: The Third Eye
entries.note: Darkvision and See Invisibility as the book; Greater Comprehension left out: every writing of the world is already readable.

entries.name: The Third Eye Benefits
entries.note: Two of the three (no foreign scripts in the world).

entries.name: Greater Comprehension
entries.note: Every writing in the world is already in a script the party reads; nothing for it to do.

entries.name: Evoker
entries.note: id `evocation`, shown as the Evoker

entries.name: Evocation Savant
entries.note: two when the catalogue has two left to give (Part D brings the rest)

entries.name: Overchannel
entries.note: the battle's judgement uses it when it is free; the player is asked under the Reactions setting

entries.name: Improved Illusions
entries.note: Minor Illusion's sound and image together: its image on the battle mat, its distraction in towns.

entries.name: Phantasmal Creatures
entries.note: The slotless phantom is taken whenever the summon is cast at its own level.

entries.name: Illusory Reality
entries.note: The thing made real is the image's crates or stones (a bridge over water or a chasm) for a minute, ending with the spell.
